text_block_list.text:
Our second summer camp has come to
an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...All that's left is to run in the Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking, you've really softened up
lately.

text_block_list.text:
What, did you like the cold treatment? I
can start
bossing you around if you'd
like.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And my sunglasses and sparkling water.
Also
bring long gloves for UV
protection.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What are you doing making me stand
beneath the
scorching sun like this?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I do ads for sunscreen. Can you imagine
the losses
I'd suffer if I get sunburned?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: I'll bring them right away, ma'am!

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm just joking. I'm not that bossy,
even at
work.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
...Felt pretty good to hear you call me
"ma'am,"
though. Hahaha.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And so, our second summer camp ends
with Gold
City laughing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
